answer: Bond every agent identity with a stake locked for a full epoch and slashed for misbehavior, so a fresh identity starts as a mere ember — cheap to create but worthless until it has done verified work. Funnel onboarding through one narrow inlet: cap how many new identities can enter per hour, so a flood of fakes jams at the gate while honest agents queue normally. Then cap what any cluster of linked identities can earn at a flat mesa: past the plateau, extra copies add nothing. Forging a thousand agents then costs more than the thousand can ever earn.
